name: @brainstorm/harness
description: Brainstorm harness hub — dogfood sessions, the dev MCP server, and orchestration. Drives the sibling shell repo at ../shell.

scripts.dogfood:build: (cd ../shell && bun run --filter @brainstorm/shell build && bun run build:apps)
scripts.dogfood:catalog: (cd ../shell && bun run --filter @brainstorm/shell build && bun run build:apps) && playwright test --config=playwright.catalog.config.ts
scripts.dogfood:backup: mkdir -p tests/dogfood/.data-backups && tar --exclude=Cache --exclude='Code Cache' --exclude=GPUCache --exclude=DawnGraphiteCache --exclude=DawnWebGPUCache --exclude=Crashpad --exclude=blob_storage -czf tests/dogfood/.data-backups/northbound-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).tar.gz -C tests/dogfood .data && ls -lh tests/dogfood/.data-backups/
